variants.title: Parecido natural
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one polished 2D character design exploration sheet for Guillermo Aladro, based on the supplied renders of his approved SVG.
Input image 1 is the identity and clothing reference, rendered directly from the master SVG. Input image 2 is an enlarged face render of the same approved SVG. They are references, not artwork to paste. Redraw him completely in a 2D animated style inspired by Dragon Ball.
Preserve Guillermo's recognizability: young adult, warm light olive skin, brown eyes, thick dark brows, a long fairly straight nose, defined lips, angular jaw, very light stubble, brown textured hair swept up with short sides. Preserve the particular face in the reference instead of substituting the face of Goku, Vegeta or any existing anime character.
Preserve his natural athletic build, plain black short-sleeve T-shirt, relaxed light blue jeans, grey-and-white low-top sneakers, and silver watch on his LEFT wrist. Hair stays brown, eyes stay brown, ordinary human proportions. No costume changes, no orange gi, no armor, no aura, no powers.

Show ONE full-body frontal three-quarter standing figure, both shoes entirely in frame, relaxed hands in pockets with wristwatch visible, occupying the left 55% of the sheet. To the right show ONE enlarged head-and-shoulders portrait of exactly the same design, facing mostly forward, calm confident expression, unobstructed face and complete hair. Keep body and portrait internally consistent. Two depictions of the same person, no other characters. Clear empty space around silhouettes.
The entire image must be unmistakably drawn 2D animation art, not a filtered photograph, not 3D, not photorealism. High-quality coherent anatomy, expressive linework, controlled cel shading. No watermark or additional text beyond the exact small top-left option label requested below.

Design direction 01 — Parecido natural: The most likeness-faithful option: 75% semirealistic anatomical facial construction, 25% Dragon Ball animation language. Fine restrained ink contours, nearly natural eye size and jaw width, small organized angular hair tufts matching his real hairstyle, three broad cel-shading values with gentle transition accents, restrained neutral colors.
